Local Translation

Inference engine settings

Connect to your running Index-Translate model in oMLX or a compatible local engine.

Saving checks the exact model and chat tokenizer, including POST /tokenize. It does not generate translations or download models.

Upgrade saved settings

Your saved settings use an earlier format. Create a backup and keep the endpoint, model, optional key and limits. Translation languages now come from each request. Existing project files stay where they are.

Inference engine

Use the port in your oMLX or runner settings and end with /v1. Use a numeric loopback address such as 127.0.0.1, rather than localhost.

Must match the model alias returned by your engine’s /v1/models endpoint.

Engine authentication

Enter your key here, never in chat. Saved keys remain in your private local settings file, in plaintext (0600 on POSIX), outside the plugin installation. The assistant receives no key value. Processes running as your user can read the file.

Generation limits and timeouts

Optional. Defaults work without editing these fields; leave a field blank to use its default. Its context window must fit the prompt and output. Changing connection settings requires a replacement translation job.

Connecting to the plugin…

Settings survive plugin updates. Failed checks preserve saved settings. Close this popup using its close button when finished.
